gloss: sheltered daughter; girl raised protected from the world

definitions.explanation: A daughter, usually of a well-off family, raised with great care and kept away from the outside world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ}で、⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: She's a sheltered girl who has never lived on her own.

examples.japanese: {箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: She was brought up with great care as a sheltered daughter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{箱入|はこい}り{娘|むすめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}い{出|だ}した→言い出す：04593_iidasu⟧。
examples.english: The company president's sheltered daughter suddenly announced she was going to study abroad.

notes:
Literally "a daughter kept in a box." It can sound affectionate or mildly teasing, and it implies naivety about everyday life.
